organizations.name: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
organizations.description: African regional human-rights body relevant to youth protest, climate, and governance accountability cases.

organizations.name: AI for Good (AI Singapore)
organizations.focus: inclusive AI literacy and workforce development
organizations.description: AI Singapore's flagship initiative scaling inclusive AI education across ASEAN and beyond. Reached 100K+ beneficiaries across 14 countries. Runs the AI Ready ASEAN Youth Challenge across all 11 ASEAN member states, trains 200 Master Trainers, and convenes national policy dialogues on AI in Education. Partners include ASEAN Foundation, Google.org, UNDP, AWS, and Micron Foundation. Also runs the AI for Good Festival — a gamified AI literacy event with interactive booths, workshops, and hackathon-style showcases.
organizations.mandate_type: national AI programme with regional reach

organizations.name: Australian Parliamentary Group for Future Generations
organizations.description: Cross-party parliamentary caucus supporting the Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill and a national Future Generations Commissioner.

organizations.name: British Group of the Inter-Parliamentary Union
organizations.description: UK parliamentary branch of the IPU, relevant to youth representation, inter-parliamentary democracy, and future-generations work.

organizations.name: California Youth Empowerment Commission
organizations.description: California's statutory youth commission, using planning and budget scrutiny to institutionalize youth voice in state governance.

organizations.name: CEPAL Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias
organizations.description: UN ECLAC network promoting anticipatory governance and legislative foresight across Latin American parliaments. Member legislatures include Chile, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Córdoba (Argentina). Partners with the UNU Future Generations Platform and delivers regional conferences, self-paced courses, and technical assistance.

organizations.name: Children's Commissioner for England
organizations.description: Independent statutory advocate for children in England, increasingly engaging intergenerational fairness, democracy anxiety, and long-term wellbeing.

organizations.name: Children's Commissioner for England
organizations.description: Independent statutory advocate for children in England, increasingly engaging intergenerational fairness, democracy anxiety, and long-term wellbeing.

organizations.name: Climate Change Authority (Australia)
organizations.description: Independent body advising on Australia's emissions targets under the Climate Change Act 2022.

organizations.name: Climate Change Committee (UK)
organizations.description: Independent statutory body under the Climate Change Act 2008 advising on emissions targets and long-term decarbonisation pathways.

organizations.name: Comisión de Desafíos del Futuro, Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Senado de Chile)
organizations.description: Standing Senate commission (since 2012) promoting strategic foresight and anticipatory governance in Chilean legislation. Co-requested the Inter-American Court climate advisory opinion AO-32/25 with Colombia and participates in CEPAL's parliamentary futures network.

organizations.name: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso de la República de Colombia)
organizations.description: Member of CEPAL's parliamentary futures network. Colombia co-requested Inter-American Court advisory opinion AO-32/25 and hosts significant climate litigation recognizing future generations (e.g., Amazon youth lawsuit, T-390/25 Awa case).

organizations.name: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso Nacional del Paraguay)
organizations.description: Parliamentary futures commission member of CEPAL's regional network. Paraguay also maintains a Congressional Futures Commission in the lower house (since 2022) as part of the Latin American parliamentary foresight movement.

organizations.name: Comisión de Futuro (Senado de México)
organizations.description: Senate futures commission participating in CEPAL's Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias.

organizations.name: Comisión de Futuro Parlamentaria (Legislatura de Córdoba)
organizations.description: First subnational parliamentary futures commission in Latin America, established May 2025 via Resolution 42800. Mandated to institutionalize strategic and anticipatory perspective in provincial legislation with technical support from COPEC and CEPAL.

organizations.name: Comisión Especial de Futuros (Asamblea General del Uruguay)
organizations.description: Special parliamentary commission created under Law 19.509 (2017) to address strategic long-term issues including climate, AI, education, and demographic change through anticipatory governance and collective intelligence methods. Chaired by Senator Blanca Rodríguez as of May 2026.

organizations.name: Comisión para el Bienestar de las Generaciones Presentes y Futuras (Illes Balears)
organizations.description: Independent consultative body under Balearic Law 10/2023 — Spain's first subnational wellbeing-for-future-generations statute. Oversees wellbeing impact assessments on legislation, budgets, and public planning; born from a popular legislative initiative led by GOB.

organizations.name: Comissão Senado do Futuro (Senado Federal do Brasil) — dissolved 2023
organizations.description: Senate Futures Commission (2013–2023) examining long-term strategic issues including technology and climate. Extinct under Senate Resolution 14/2023 (June 2023), transformed into the Comissão de Defesa da Democracia. Brazil's CEPAL network participation continues through other chambers, but the dedicated Senate futures mandate ended.

organizations.name: Consejo para la Planificación Estratégica de Córdoba (CoPEC)
organizations.description: Provincial strategic planning council providing technical assistance to Córdoba's parliamentary Future Commission and co-organizing CEPAL training on demographic ageing and legislative foresight.

organizations.name: Conselho do Futuro (Plataforma Crescimento Sustentável)
organizations.description: Youth-led council within the Sustainable Growth Platform producing policy papers and engaging decision-makers on intergenerational fairness principles. Fills part of the institutional gap where Portugal lacks a statutory future-generations commissioner.

organizations.name: Constitutional Court of Colombia
organizations.description: Colombia's constitutional court; landmark climate, Indigenous, and future generations jurisprudence including T-390/25 Awá ruling and rights-of-nature precedents.

organizations.name: Constitutional Court of Hungary
organizations.description: Hungary's constitutional court, relevant to child-protection and intergenerational-justice constitutional disputes.

organizations.name: Constitutional Court of Korea
organizations.description: South Korea's constitutional court, which imposed a deadline for climate-law reform to protect future generations.

organizations.name: Corte Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (Inter-American Court of Human Rights)
organizations.description: Regional human rights court whose Advisory Opinion AO-32/25 (May 2025) recognized a right to a healthy climate and affirmed intergenerational equity as essential to climate rights across 20 OAS member states.

organizations.name: Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ)
organizations.description: White House council overseeing NEPA environmental review for federal actions.

organizations.name: Court of Justice of the European Union
organizations.description: Supreme court of the European Union interpreting EU law, including environmental and climate obligations under the EU Charter and directives.

organizations.name: Court of King's Bench of Alberta
organizations.description: Alberta's superior court, relevant to privacy, AI, and constitutional litigation with long-term implications.

organizations.name: Court of Session, Scotland
organizations.description: Scotland's supreme civil court, central to environmental and climate litigation with long-term consequences.

organizations.name: Democracy Development Program
organizations.focus: democracy, youth participation, and civic education
organizations.description: South African civic organisation focused on democracy, participation, intergenerational fairness, and evidence on youth voter apathy and engagement.

organizations.name: Digital Safety Commission of Canada
organizations.focus: online safety and AI chatbot duties for children
organizations.description: Proposed federal regulator under Bill C-34 for child online safety, AI chatbots, transparency, and enforcement duties.

organizations.name: EFTA Court
organizations.description: The EFTA Court interprets EEA law, including climate-impact and lifecycle-emissions standards affecting future generations.

organizations.name: eSafety Commissioner (Australia)

organizations.name: EU Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport
organizations.description: First explicit EU-level institutional mandate for intergenerational fairness, held by Commissioner Glenn Micallef from 2024.

organizations.name: European Commission
organizations.description: Executive branch of the European Union, responsible for proposing legislation and implementing decisions including the EU Strategy for Intergenerational Fairness.

organizations.name: European Court of Human Rights
organizations.description: The Council of Europe court for human-rights cases, including climate and environmental rights claims.

organizations.name: European Parliament

organizations.description: Directly elected EU legislature, a major venue for youth, platform, digital-rights, and climate governance signals.

organizations.name: Federal Court of Australia
organizations.description: Australia's federal trial court, hearing major public-law and climate-related appeals.

organizations.name: Finance Commission
organizations.description: India's constitutional finance commission, relevant to intergenerational taxation, devolution, and fiscal fairness debates.

organizations.name: Future Generations Commissioner for Wales
organizations.description: Independent statutory role under the Well-being of Future Generations (Wales) Act 2015. Acts as guardian for future generations' interests in Wales, monitoring public bodies and issuing recommendations.

organizations.name: GOB (Grup Balear d'Ornitologia i Defensa de la Naturalesa)
organizations.description: Balearic environmental NGO that led the popular legislative initiative (ILP) resulting in Law 10/2023 on wellbeing for present and future generations — the first successful citizens' initiative of its kind in Spain.

organizations.name: Guardian of Future Generations (Malta)
organizations.description: Statutory commission under Malta's Sustainable Development Act (Cap. 521, Article 8) safeguarding intergenerational and intragenerational sustainable development. Chairperson and four members appointed by the Prime Minister after Opposition consultation. Advisory powers include policy review, impact-assessment scrutiny, public consultations, and information requests from government entities. Cited in the EU Intergenerational Fairness Strategy (March 2026) as a member-state institutional model.

organizations.name: Hawaii Office of Environmental Quality Control (OEQC)
organizations.description: Administers Hawaii Environmental Policy Act reviews with constitutional intergenerational mandate.
